title: Testing TypeScript React
description: Write tests for TypeScript React components with proper typing.

data.text: Testing React components written in TypeScript requires understanding both testing libraries and TypeScript's type system.

data.title: Typed Component Test

terms.definition: Library for testing React components with DOM queries
JavaScript testing framework with mocking support
A mock that preserves the original type signatures

data.title: Type Safety in Tests
data.text: TypeScript in tests catches prop mismatches early. If you rename a prop in your component, TypeScript will highlight all affected tests.

items.question: Do I need to test TypeScript code differently?
items.answer: The testing approach is the same, but TypeScript gives you better autocomplete and catches type mismatches before runtime.

items.question: How do I mock a typed function?
items.answer: Use jest.fn() with the same type signature, or use jest.MockedFunction<typeof fn> when mocking modules.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Type-safe tests are easier to maintain and more reliable.
